name: @parallel-slices/scaffold-baseline
description: Exact framework and UI versions applied to newly generated projects.

packageManagerHolds.npm: npm 11 and 12 require newer Node.js patch levels than the documented Node.js 22 and 24 LTS prerequisite.
packageManagerHolds.pnpm: pnpm 11 requires a newer Node.js 22 patch level than the documented Node.js 22 LTS prerequisite.

compatibilityHolds.@eslint/js: ESLint 10 is held until eslint-plugin-react declares support.
compatibilityHolds.@types/node: Node types track the Node.js 24 LTS initialization target.
compatibilityHolds.eslint: ESLint 10 is held until eslint-plugin-react declares support.
compatibilityHolds.typescript: TypeScript is held below 6.1 for the typescript-eslint peer range.
